answer: Forging 549 of these means building 549 separate callout histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The defence rests on mountain rescue team membership with callout history: callouts answered with one team for years. The delta check is what stops the copy-paste farm: Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The orchard record is public, the pulse cost is per identity, and 549 aliases cost 549 times one honest seat.
